'''Demographics''' was a subdivision of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Media Division]]. It studied the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector's]] consumer base and determined economic trends, including purchasing trends and attitudes. This information was passed to [[Entertainment]] and [[Product Advertising]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
